description: This file defines a set of Sass functions and mixins related to viewport breakpoints for responsive design. It includes functions for determining next, minimum, and maximum breakpoint widths, as well as infixes and media query mixins for applying styles at specific or ranges of breakpoints.

methods.name: breakpoint-next
methods.description: Returns the name of the next breakpoint after the given one, based on the list of breakpoint names.

methods.name: breakpoint-min
methods.description: Returns the minimum width of the specified breakpoint, or null if it is the smallest.

methods.name: breakpoint-max
methods.description: Returns the maximum width of the specified breakpoint, adjusted by subtracting 0.02px to avoid issues with fractional viewports.

methods.name: breakpoint-infix
methods.description: Returns an infix string for the breakpoint (e.g., '-sm'), or an empty string for the smallest breakpoint.
